hints.title: Occurrence Counter and Sequential Buffer
hints.text: Track each number occurrence frequency with a dictionary and append additions into a sequential buffer.

hints.title: Lazy Invalidation Strategy
hints.text: Rather than removing duplicates immediately from the queue, pop stale values from the front when querying.

hints.title: Front Cleanup Condition
hints.text: While the queue is non-empty and the front element has frequency greater than 1, discard it.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total number of elements added
complexity.notes: Each value is inserted once and popped at most once across all showFirstUnique calls, giving O(1) amortized time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning elements linearly on every query yields O(N) query time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual queue and frequency map storage bounds memory to O(N) while maintaining amortized constant time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Queue with lazy deletion paired with frequency dictionary.
